relations.note: Highland migrants in Madre de Dios equate Chullachaqui with this Andean dangerous spirit.
relations.source: Regan, Hacia la tierra sin mal

relations.note: Christianized narrators classify Chullachaqui as a devil or demon, without making them separate interacting beings.
Regionally treated as another name or locally equivalent forest being.
relations.source: Regan, Hacia la tierra sin mal
